questions.question: A psalm praising the LORD's works says He provides food for those who fear Him. What else does He remember forever?
A psalm praising the LORD's works says He showed His people the power of His works. How did He do it?

answers.text: By giving them the inheritance of the nations
By raising their king above all the nations
By sending fire upon all of their enemies

questions.question: A psalm praising the great works of the LORD describes His name in which way?

answers.text: It is hidden from the nations
It is spoken only by priests
